# Mich Candelaria: GoHighLevel CRM, Websites & Conversion Funnels

> Mich Candelaria launches reliable GoHighLevel pipelines, websites and conversion funnels that turn clicks into booked calls with 24/7 automation. Backed by 1,600+ hours of production delivery, each build connects, automates, and tests your CRM so incoming inquiries turn into booked calls.

- [The 3 Core Pillars](/#pillars): High-converting websites, targeted conversion funnels, and end-to-end GHL automation.
- [Case Studies](/#work): A payment collections system, a purchase-focused email nurture audit, and two website builds.
- [How We Work](/#process): 20-minute pipeline and funnel audit, system blueprint and build, end-to-end QA and team handoff.
- [Engagement Options](/#offers): GHL Fix & Automation, Website + GHL Setup, and Monthly GHL Support.
- [About](/#about): Operator profile and the three core operating principles.
- [FAQ](/#faq): Existing GoHighLevel accounts, live campaign safety, timelines, pricing, timezones, handoff and support.
